subject: Production latency spike & 503s — private cluster hotpath mitigation request
messages:
From: Alina Rivera <alina.rivera@sparrowhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@sparrowhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-24T17:12:00Z
Subject: Urgent: production latency spike and 503s on private cluster

Connor —

We started seeing a major regression on our private cluster (vpc-nyc-3) after the 03:30am deploy: p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.2s, p99 to ~3.4s, and 503s increased from 0.2% to ~6% across inference endpoints. Throughput also dropped ~25% even though traffic stayed flat. Attached are the diag bundle and an end-to-end trace (sparrow_diag_2028-09-24.log, trace-2028-09-24.html).

This is blocking our booking flow — leadership is asking for an immediate remediation plan and an exec sync. Can Redwood put senior infra on this and tell us the short-term mitigations (we need <1% 5xx and p95 <300ms ASAP) and the longer-term root-cause plan?

We are prepared to accept a temporary routing to hosted endpoints if you recommend it, but we need clear failover steps and an ETA. Please advise next steps and availability for an ops call in the next hour.

Thanks,
Alina Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering, Sparrow Health
attachments: sparrow_diag_2028-09-24.log, trace-2028-09-24.html

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alina Rivera <alina.rivera@sparrowhealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-24T17:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: production latency spike and 503s on private cluster

Thanks Alina — I see the traces. Marissa: can you join the call and lead customer comms? Stephanie and Vivek — please triage immediately (kernel/serving runtime + KV cache). Initial hypotheses: 1) KV cache eviction storm after model rollout (new prompt distribution), 2) attention-kernel kernel candidate regression introduced by the last runtime build, or 3) a batching/backpressure interaction for long contexts.

Immediate asks:
- Stephanie: pull kvcache metrics (hit/miss, evictions, per-shard mem) and attach CSV to the thread.
- Vivek: check recent runtime build hashes on the private cluster and diff with last known-good. Look for kernel changes or quantization toggles.
- Marissa: prepare an ops note for Sparrow leadership explaining short-term mitigations: (A) enable hosted fallback routing for high-latency requests, (B) increase KV cache allocation by +30% on the cluster, (C) temporarily reduce max batch size to limit tail latency.

Goal: actionable mitigation within 60 minutes, post-mortem and remediation plan in 24 hours. I will set up a 30-minute war room now.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_initial_analysis_2028-09-24.txt

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alina Rivera <alina.rivera@sparrowhealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-24T17:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: production latency spike and 503s on private cluster

On Sep 24, 2028 17:25, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Immediate asks:
> - Stephanie: pull kvcache metrics (hit/miss, evictions, per-shard mem) and attach CSV to the thread.

Attached: kvcache_metrics_2028-09-24.csv — summary below.
- Observation: 3x increase in eviction rate starting 03:32am local; cache pressure correlates tightly with p99 spikes.
- Per-shard behavior: one shard shows >60% eviction vs others at ~12% (hot shard).
- Root-cause candidate: model variant A (deployed at 03:27) changes average context prefix patterns causing cache churn on hot shard.

Short-term mitigations implemented (17:35):
1) Increased kvcache allocation on vpc-nyc-3 by 35% (monitored).
2) Reduced max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 on the affected pool.
3) Enabled prefix-based caching window (60s) to stabilize repeated prefixes.

Initial impact (17:40): p95 dropped to ~280ms, p99 to ~1.1s, and 5xx rate decreased to 1.8%. Still above target but moving in the right direction. Will monitor and report back.

Stephanie Nguyen
Infrastructure Software Engineer — Redwood Inference
attachments: kvcache_metrics_2028-09-24.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alina Rivera <alina.rivera@sparrowhealth.com>
Date: 2028-09-24T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Urgent: production latency spike and 503s on private cluster

Quick update and escalation ask —
- Checked runtime deploy: the customer had drifted to runtime-build sha: a3f7c9d which includes a performance micro-optimization to the fused-attention kernel that, under certain long-context distributions, increases temporary mem pressure and can interact poorly with our shard eviction heuristic.
- Action: rolling back that runtime build on the affected pool reduced kernel memory churn in our staging repro and removed the p99 multiplier in tests.

Recommend the following next steps and asks for execs:
1) Rollback the runtime on vpc-nyc-3 (I can coordinate; ETA ~25 mins).
2) Post-rollback: keep increased kvcache (+35%) and reduced batch size for 6 hours, then we can run controlled canary of patched kernel with telemetry.
3) Exec ask: authorize a one-time credit or SLA exception if we need to route customer traffic to hosted fallbacks for up to 4 hours while we complete remediation. Sparrow leadership is asking for an explicit concession.

Laura, Marissa — can you join a 18:15 UTC exec huddle with Sparrow leads? They requested an exec-level attendee.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alina Rivera <alina.rivera@sparrowhealth.com>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@sparrowhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-25T09:05:00Z
Subject: Action plan and next steps — Sparrow Health private cluster incident

Alina / Marco — thank you for the rapid signal and for providing traces. Summary and plan: 

Summary (post-mitigation):
- We observed a cache eviction storm correlated to the model variant A rollout, exacerbated by a recent fused-attention kernel micro-optimization (runtime build a3f7c9d).
- Short-term mitigations applied (Sep 24 17:35 UTC): +35% KV cache allocation, max_batch_size reduced to 32, prefix caching window enabled. Immediate rollback of the runtime build commenced and completed at 18:05 UTC.
- Impact: p95 moved from ~1.2s -> ~220–300ms, p99 from ~3.4s -> ~700–1,100ms, 5xx dropped to ~0.9%. Traffic resumed to normal throughput.

Agreed next steps (owner / ETA):
- 24h: run controlled canary of patched kernel (Vivek / 24h) — metric gating: p95 < 300ms, 5xx < 0.5%.
- 48h: permanent runtime patch release + automated kvcache shard rebalancer (Infra / 48h).
- 72h: joint post-mortem and RCA doc (Connor / 72h) — will include request/response traces, guardrails to prevent shard-hotness, and an ops playbook for automatic hosted fallback.
- Exec ask: Vivek requested approval for a temporary customer credit / SLA concession if hosted fallback is required in future incidents; Connor will follow up with finance and account team.

War room recording and ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4321
Runbook (internal): https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sparrow/perf/runbook-2028-09-24

We will keep this thread updated with telemetry. Connor will set up the post-mortem doc and share a draft within 24 hours. Please ping me directly if anything regresses.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
